text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... These kinds of games are pretty 
tough! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm even more fired up! Would you like 
to figure out a winning strategy together?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Strategy meetings with you, Trainer... 
make me feel like anything is possible, 
and it gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next time we do this, let's clean 
the entire box out completely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
